slug: 2025-06-03 Teraco Unveils 8th Data Centre, JB5, Strengthening Africa's Digital Infrastructure

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Teraco announced completion of its eighth data centre, JB5 at the Isando campus (12 halls, 120MVA supply), bringing the campus to 70MW critical power; no completion date is given, so the published date is used.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
